title: Deer in Forest Painting
description: A brown deer with large antlers stands facing forward in the center of the picture. The deer is in a forest with tall dark green trees behind it and red and yellow flowers at its feet.
prompt: A brown deer with large branched antlers stands facing the viewer in the center of a misty forest. Tall dark green pine trees fill the background under a foggy sky while the ground around the deer's feet is covered in red and yellow wildflowers. The deer has a calm expression with direct gaze and detailed fur texture.
